test_name: Verify Product Browsing in Men's Category
description: Ensure the user can browse and navigate through products listed in the Men's category.
steps: Navigate to the Men's category page using the main navigation menu.
Scroll through the product listings to view available items.
Click on the 'ATID Blue Shoes' product link.
Verify that the product details page for 'ATID Blue Shoes' loads successfully.
expected_results: The Men's category page is successfully loaded.
The user can view a list of products in the Men's category.
Navigating to a product details page displays the correct product information.
edge_cases: No products are displayed on the Men's category page.
Broken links for product images or titles.
Incorrect product details loaded when clicking on a product.
data_requirements: At least one product available in the Men's category.
Correct product details for 'ATID Blue Shoes' in the backend.
dependencies: The Men's category page is accessible.
The product details pages are functional.
Products are loaded from the database successfully.
api_interactions: Fetch product details for the Men's category.
Fetch product details for 'ATID Blue Shoes'.
performance_metrics: Page load time for the Men's category page.
Page load time for the product details page.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure proper ARIA roles for navigation links.
Verify color contrast for text and background on the category page.
